status: first implementation study, not final art approval
garden: Use case: illustration-story. Create a production background plate for Joker's Mate desktop game, wide 16:9. Vintage European 19th century fairy tale pen-and-ink etching, delicate detailed black hatching and muted watercolor, aged ivory paper, sage green gardens, warm earth brown tree trunks, antique gold light. View from a palace garden balcony: grand Victorian palace far away across upper quarter, symmetrical trimmed hedges and small distant fountains, fantastical mushrooms and old trees framing only the far left and right edges. Bottom edge a low stone balcony rail. Center and lower middle must be quiet spacious low contrast lawn, suitable behind an interactive chess board and poker cards. Original illustration, elegant restrained storybook Art Nouveau atmosphere. No people, hands, playing cards, chess pieces, chessboard, coins, lettering, logos, signs, interface, or watermark. This is only scenery, all gameplay objects will be rendered separately.
characters: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite sheet for Joker's Mate. Reference image is character/style reference only: retain the literal playing-card torso, human face, arms and legs, and unmistakable chess-piece hat, vintage pen-and-ink muted watercolor. Make exactly SIX separate full-body sprites on a transparent background, arranged in a precise THREE COLUMN TWO ROW grid, each sprite centered in its own equal cell with generous padding and no overlap. Row 1 left to right: QUEEN ornate queen crown, KING king crown with cross, BISHOP pointed split mitre. Row 2: PAWN round ball topped pawn hat, KNIGHT horse head helmet, ROOK crenellated rook tower hat. All face forward. All have identical plain ivory upright rectangular playing-card torsos, no card numbers, no suits, no pictorial faces on the cards, no lettering anywhere. Head above torso, little arms at sides outside torso, two legs below. Entire torso region must be clean blank ivory to receive programmatic card data. Tall readable chess hats, clearly different silhouettes. Full body including shoes within each grid cell. Style faithful to reference but isolated sprites only. No scene, floor, labels, grid lines, props, shadows, or watermark. Actual alpha transparency.
garden_overhead: Square game environment background, perfectly overhead top-down view of a Victorian palace garden lawn, vintage 19th century storybook pen-and-ink with strong slightly irregular black ink contours and fine hatching, flat delicate watercolor on aged ivory paper. Muted olive sage green, earthy browns. Central 85 percent is quiet open grass with subtle sparse pen texture suitable for overlaying an interactive 8x8 chess grid. Around the outer margins ONLY low trimmed hedges, tiny flowers, stone paths and small mushrooms. Exact orthographic overhead view, no horizon, no palace facade, no perspective. No chess pieces, no characters, no playing cards, no grid, no lettering, no numbers, no wooden board, no table, no photorealism. It should look like a page from an antique illustrated fairy tale, not a satellite photograph.
